declared_exclusions.item: Raising aws-waf-logs-opal-gateway retention from 90 d to the face's 400 d
declared_exclusions.reason: Issuer ruling 19614(a): 90 d STAYS this round. It clears FWD-5's ACCEPT bar and S5-AC5's own '>= 7 days', and the face's bound states 'retention values are settings; >= 7 d is the bar'. Raising a live control's retention in a module this task order does not name would be an unrequested mid-round change; if the estate wants 400 d there it is a round-2 cell naming the correct carrier.

declared_exclusions.item: Changing opal-data-security's object-ownership setting to enable legacy CloudFront standard logging
declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden by the face's own bound ('the bucket's ownership/ACL setting is not changed to satisfy legacy CloudFront logging -- use the v2 delivery path instead'). The bucket reads BucketOwnerEnforced; the v2 path was taken and ownership was read before and after every apply to prove it did not move.

declared_exclusions.item: Granting the legacy regional ELB account principal (127311923021) alongside the service principal for ALB log delivery
declared_exclusions.reason: Would have widened past the face's 'that prefix ONLY' by adding a second principal that may be unnecessary. The service-principal form was asserted alone and VERIFIED by the enablement itself: elbv2 test-writes on switch-on and refuses if the policy denies, so the apply succeeding is the measurement. Granting both would have made the correct one unknowable.

declared_exclusions.item: Any alarm, metric filter, subscription filter, notification, dashboard, GuardDuty / Security Hub / Config enablement
declared_exclusions.reason: FWD-5 is a NAMED exception to the standing alert/monitor moratorium and the exception is for the RECORD only. The alarm pair is OP-s-6's cell and the subscription filter is OP-s-14's, each with its own authorization. S5-AC6 is the control that nothing beyond logging rode in.

declared_exclusions.item: Any request sent to a production surface to make records arrive
declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden by the face ('No request is sent to any production surface by this seat; production traffic is the writer'). It is also why S5-AC2 and S5-AC3 file UNCOMPUTABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION rather than FAIL: a probe would both breach the bound and make this seat the writer, destroying the very discriminator those criteria exist to produce.
